user_prompt: I need to set up automated safety checks for our engineering change orders and material updates before they go to production. We've been manually validating everything against our compliance requirements, but it's slowing down our releases. Can you help me automate this validation process?

result_preview.title: Safety Compliance Automation Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates safety validation across engineering changes, materials, and product items.
result_preview.description: Monitors and processes engineering changes, materials, and product items to enforce safety compliance requirements and automate BOM validation workflows. Coordinates supplier qualification assessments and initiates compliance remediation actions when safety risks or regulatory gaps are detected. Automates incident prevention through continuous validation of product configurations against safety standards.
useCases: Safety officers ensure all engineering changes trigger integrated compliance assessments across the organization.
EHS team automates review of engineering changes to ensure material and product modifications meet safety and regulatory requirements before production
Compliance automation prevents unsafe or non-compliant product items from advancing to manufacturing
Compliance teams automate material and process safety validation to reduce manual review time.
Operations leadership maintains consistent safety standards across all product variants and manufacturing locations.

result_preview.title: Bill of Materials Compliance Validator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates BOM validation and supplier qualification checks across engineering changes.
result_preview.description: Monitors engineering changes and material specifications to automatically validate bill of materials compliance against supplier qualifications. Coordinates BOM updates with product item definitions while processing supplier approval workflows. Automates compliance verification across product variants to ensure manufacturing readiness and regulatory adherence.
useCases: Manufacturing confirms all components in the product structure meet material safety and engineering requirements.
Engineering change management ensures BOMs remain compliant when modifications occur.
Quality assurance validates material selections before production execution.

args.reason: Automates safety compliance validation of engineering changes and materials against regulatory requirements before production release, eliminating manual compliance checks.
